create_clustering_model: create an AgglomerativeClustering model with distance_threshold=0 and n_clusters=None on iris data
plot_dendrogram_visualization: plot a hierarchical clustering dendrogram from an AgglomerativeClustering model with truncate_mode level
fit_clustering_model: fit an AgglomerativeClustering model on iris dataset features to compute linkage structure
load_iris_dataset: load the iris dataset using sklearn.datasets.load_iris for clustering example data
generate_linkage_matrix: generate a linkage matrix from AgglomerativeClustering children and distances for scipy dendrogram
